maxStackSize.label: Max Stack Size
maxStackSize.description: Every item that stacks is raised to this size, except large stacks (see Large Stack Size). Single items (weapons, armour ...) stay single, and items that already stack higher keep their size. Restart required.

largeStackSize.label: Large Stack Size
largeStackSize.description: Items that stack to the Large Stack Threshold or more in the game (building blocks ...) are raised to this size instead. 65535 is the most the game can hold. Restart required.

largeStackThreshold.label: Large Stack Threshold
largeStackThreshold.description: Items whose own stack size in the game is at least this get the Large Stack Size. 65535 treats every item the same. The log lists which items count as large. Restart required.

changelog: First version: one Max Stack Size setting for every stackable item.
1.1.0: new Large Stack Size (65535 by default) for items that stack to the Large Stack Threshold (1000 by default) or more in the game, such as building blocks.
